tldr: 台積電加碼亞利桑那至約2,650億美元，並預告下半年先進製程漲價。
金管會定調保險監理三方向，並推22項金融大回饋指引。
美股週一大漲，那斯達克+2.08%、標普+1.49%、道瓊+1.41%，油價因美伊重談走弱。
央行估2026成長約2.7%、CPI約2%，6月CPI年增2.6%。

items.title_en: TAIEX edges higher to close at 43,386 on Aug 3 (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數收在43,386.41點，上漲266.66點、漲幅0.62%，成交金額約8,458億元。權值科技股領軍，資金在AI財報與擴產題材前布局。收盤貼近歷史高檔，顯示風險偏好仍具韌性，惟市場對評價面與海外降息節奏保持審慎。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 266.66 points, or 0.62%, to finish the Monday session at 43,386.41, with turnover of about NT$845.8 billion. Gains were led by heavyweight tech names as investors positioned ahead of further AI-related earnings and capacity news. The steady close keeps the index near record territory, signaling resilient risk appetite despite lingering caution over valuations and the pace of overseas rate cuts.

items.title_en: TSMC rises 2.27% to NT$2,370, powering the index (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 台積電上漲2.27%、收2,370元，為大盤最大貢獻個股。買盤來自AI加速器需求續強，以及公司先進製程與封裝產能持續擴張的樂觀預期。作為權重最大個股，台積電走勢牽動指數方向，其動能仍是台股後市關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor advanced 2.27% to close at NT$2,370, acting as the single largest contributor to the benchmark's gain. Buying was fueled by sustained optimism over AI accelerator demand and the company's expanding advanced-node and packaging pipeline. As the market's dominant weighting, TSMC's strength underpins broad index direction, and its momentum will remain a key swing factor for Taiwan equities in the sessions ahead.

items.title_zh: 台積電加碼亞利桑那、擴產搶AI晶片商機（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: TSMC deepens US$265bn Arizona push to capture AI-chip demand (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 傳台積電將亞利桑那投資規模推升至約2,650億美元，興建先進製程廠以承接美系客戶暴增的AI加速器訂單。擴大在地布局有助分散地緣風險、貼近關鍵客戶，但短期資本支出與成本壓力同步升高。對台灣供應鏈而言，此舉代表先進製程產能需求可望延續至下一輪投資循環。
items.summary_en: TSMC is reported to be scaling its Arizona commitment toward roughly US$265 billion as it builds out leading-edge fabs to serve surging AI accelerator orders from US customers. The expanded footprint strengthens the company's geographic diversification and closeness to key clients, but also raises near-term capital-spending and cost pressures. For Taiwan's supply chain, the buildout signals durable demand for advanced-node capacity through the next investment cycle.

items.title_zh: 先進製程與封裝下半年喊漲、CoWoS產能翻倍（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: Advanced-node and packaging price hikes flagged for H2 2026 (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 業界指出，台積電先進製程與封裝將於2026下半年至2027年再度調漲，CoWoS年底產能規劃倍增。核心課題是產能追不上AI需求，而非訂單不足。漲價有助台廠晶片鏈維持毛利韌性，但產能吃緊恐外溢至下游AI伺服器與零組件供應商。
items.summary_en: Industry reporting indicates TSMC will raise pricing on advanced processes and packaging into late 2026 and 2027, with CoWoS capacity slated to grow several-fold by year-end. The core issue is capacity struggling to keep pace with AI demand rather than a shortage of orders. Firmer pricing supports margin resilience across the Taiwan chip chain, while capacity tightness could ripple into downstream AI-server and component suppliers.

items.title_zh: 金管會揭保險監理三大方向（2026-07-22）
items.title_en: FSC sets three supervisory priorities for insurers (2026-07-22)
items.summary_zh: 金管會指出，保險業今年接軌IFRS 17等新制，未來監理聚焦三面向：推動AI科技轉型、引導綠色金融投資，並建構全齡金融體系、擴大微型保險，以因應超高齡社會與氣候變遷。此方向促使壽險業加速現代化與長期商品設計，牽動全業資本配置與法遵重點。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission outlined three focus areas for insurance oversight as the sector adopts IFRS 17 and related regimes this year: driving AI-led technology transformation, steering green-finance investment, and building an all-age financial framework with wider micro-insurance to meet super-aged-society and climate challenges. The direction pushes insurers toward modernization and long-horizon product design, shaping capital allocation and compliance priorities across the industry.

items.title_zh: 金管會推金融大回饋、提22項參考項目（2026-07-29）
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布金融大回饋指引，就社會、客戶、員工三面向列出22項參考項目。銀行可減少手續費、提高數位帳戶優惠；保險業可設計具回饋機制商品，或提供小額快速理賠、住院即時給付。此舉引導業者朝友善定價與服務發展，鼓勵民眾訂定長期理財規劃，也可能加劇費用與優惠競爭。
items.summary_en: The FSC published a financial-giveback guideline listing 22 reference measures across society, customers and employees. Banks are encouraged to cut fees and lift digital-account benefits, while insurers can design reward-linked products and offer small, fast claims and instant hospitalization payouts. The framework nudges the industry toward customer-friendly pricing and service, encouraging households to set long-term financial plans and potentially intensifying competition on fees and benefits.

items.title_zh: 土地銀行獲准承作高資產客戶業務（2026-07）
items.title_en: Land Bank cleared to serve high-asset clients (2026-07)
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意臺灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務。該制度放寬銀行對資產達新臺幣1億元以上客戶提供多元商品與諮詢的條件。此舉擴大爭取台灣超高資產客群的業者版圖，呼應台灣打造區域財富管理與資產中心的政策目標。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved Taiwan's Land Bank to offer financial products and services under the high-asset-client regime, which eases rules for banks serving customers with NT$100 million or more in assets and widens the menu of products and advisory they can access. The move expands the pool of institutions competing for Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth segment, supporting the island's ambition to grow as a regional wealth-management and asset hub.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正利變型保險商品規範（2026-07）
items.title_en: FSC revises rules for interest-sensitive insurance products (2026-07)
items.summary_zh: 金管會修正「人身保險業辦理利率變動型保險商品業務應注意事項」，並預告修正保經代管理規則，屬提升商品透明度與投保便利、接軌國際保險工作的一環。對財富管理客戶而言，利變型保單的調整將影響儲蓄兼保障型商品在長期理財與傳承規劃中的結構與定價。
items.summary_en: The commission amended the guidelines governing interest-variable life-insurance products, part of a broader effort that also includes proposed changes to insurance-agent and broker management rules. The revisions aim to improve product transparency and consumer convenience while aligning with international insurance work. For wealth clients, adjustments to interest-sensitive policies affect how savings-and-protection products are structured and priced within long-term financial and succession planning.

items.title_zh: 2026遺贈稅課稅級距因CPI累漲逾10%上調
items.title_en: 2026 estate & gift tax brackets widened as cumulative CPI tops 10%
items.summary_zh: 台灣2026年遺產稅與贈與稅課稅級距向上調整，因自上次調整以來CPI累計上漲12.42%、達遺贈稅法第12-1條逾10%的調整門檻。級距金額提高，使高資產族群的遺產與大額贈與稅負相對減輕。此變動改變傳承與贈與規劃的稅務試算，今年成為檢視財富移轉時點與架構的自然節點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's estate and gift tax brackets were adjusted upward for 2026 after cumulative inflation since the last revision reached 12.42%, exceeding the 10% threshold that triggers indexation under Article 12-1. The higher bracket thresholds modestly ease the effective tax burden on high-net-worth estates and large gifts. The change reshapes the arithmetic of succession and gifting plans, making the year a natural checkpoint for reviewing wealth-transfer timing and structures.

items.title_zh: 免稅額維持不變、CPI連動機制使年度檢視更關鍵
items.title_en: Exemptions held flat; CPI-linked mechanism keeps annual review in focus
items.summary_zh: 級距調整之際，2026年遺贈稅的免稅額與各項扣除額維持不變。依法定機制，當CPI較上次調整累計上漲達10%以上，財政部應於每年12月底前重算並公告次年適用金額。「級距升、免稅額平」的分歧結果，意味納稅人須密切留意年底公告，門檻與規劃假設可能逐年變動。
items.summary_en: While brackets moved, the core exemption and deduction amounts for estate and gift tax were left unchanged for 2026. Under the statutory mechanism, the Ministry of Finance recalculates and announces applicable figures each December when cumulative CPI rises 10% or more from the prior adjustment. The split outcome — brackets up, exemptions flat — means taxpayers should track the year-end announcement closely, as thresholds and planning assumptions can shift from one year to the next.

items.title_en: Central bank pegs 2026 growth near 2.7%, inflation around 2%
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行預測2026年台灣經濟成長約2.68%、全年CPI約2.0%，每人GDP約4萬5,610美元。各季成長不均，反映出口與投資動能起伏。成長平穩、通膨受控的基準情境支持政策保持耐心，但經濟仍受AI科技需求、全球利率與能源情勢波動的牽動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank projects 2026 GDP growth of roughly 2.68% and full-year CPI near 2.0%, with per-capita GDP around US$45,610. Quarterly growth is seen uneven across the year as export and investment momentum ebbs and flows. The steady-growth, contained-inflation baseline supports a patient policy stance, but leaves the economy exposed to swings in AI-tech demand and global rate and energy conditions.

items.title_en: June CPI up 2.6% y/y as price pressures gradually cool
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月消費者物價指數較上年同月漲2.60%、較上月漲0.52%，上半年平均漲1.70%。預測機構認為隨全球通膨趨緩，物價將緩步回落，全年約在2%上下。溫和降溫給予政策維持利率不變的空間，民眾與投資人則關注能源與食品波動是否打亂反通膨趨勢。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June consumer price index rose 2.60% from a year earlier and 0.52% on the month, with the first-half average up 1.70%. Forecasters expect prices to drift lower as global inflation eases, keeping the full-year path near or slightly above 2%. The gradual cooldown gives policymakers room to hold rates steady, while households and investors watch whether energy and food swings disrupt the disinflation trend.

items.title_en: Fed holds at 3.50–3.75% as markets shift toward hikes over cuts (2026-07-29)
items.summary_zh: 聯準會7月會議維持聯邦資金利率3.50%–3.75%，失業率約4.2%、核心通膨仍高於目標。物價僵固與夏季能源衝擊，使市場改為預期年底前升息1至2碼，而非年初預期的降息。鷹派傾向支撐美元與美債殖利率，是台灣出口導向、對利率敏感股市的重要背景。
items.summary_en: After its July meeting, the Federal Reserve kept the federal funds target range at 3.50%–3.75%, with unemployment around 4.2% and core inflation still above target. Sticky prices and the summer's energy shock have pushed markets to price one to two hikes into year-end rather than the cuts expected earlier in 2026. The hawkish tilt keeps the dollar and US yields firm, a key backdrop for Taiwan's export-heavy, rate-sensitive equity market.

items.title_zh: 美伊重啟談判、油價下挫約5%（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: Oil slides about 5% as US–Iran talks resume (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 布蘭特原油週一下跌約5%至每桶84美元以下，因川普表示將重啟對伊朗談判，並在波灣盟友力勸下暫停軍事打擊。此跌勢回吐7月因荷莫茲海峽供應疑慮而暴漲逾20%的部分漲幅。油價回落減輕台灣等能源進口國的輸入型通膨壓力並提振風險偏好，惟60天談判期使消息面風險仍高。
items.summary_en: Brent crude fell roughly 5% to below US$84 a barrel on Monday after President Trump said negotiations with Iran would resume and a planned military strike was suspended at the urging of Gulf allies. The pullback unwinds part of July's 20%-plus spike driven by Hormuz supply fears. Cheaper crude eases imported-inflation pressure for energy importers like Taiwan and lifts risk appetite, though the 60-day talks leave headline risk elevated.

items.title_zh: 美股大漲、油價因美伊重談走弱（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: US stocks surge as oil slides on renewed Iran talks (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 美股週一勁揚，那斯達克漲約2.08%、標普500漲1.49%、道瓊漲1.41%，油價因中東緊張緩和而下跌，投資人並為財報與經濟數據密集的一週做準備。川普釋出重啟對伊朗談判訊號後，市場風險偏好回升，帶動全面上漲。
items.summary_en: Wall Street rallied Monday, with the Nasdaq up about 2.08%, the S&P 500 gaining 1.49% and the Dow adding 1.41%, as crude tumbled on eased Middle East tensions and investors braced for a heavy week of earnings and economic data. The broad advance reflected renewed risk appetite after President Trump signaled fresh negotiations with Iran.

items.title_zh: 亞股週一漲跌互見、情緒趨穩（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: Asian markets mixed on Monday as sentiment steadies (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 亞股8月3日表現分歧：日經下跌約0.94%至63,754.90點、中國滬深300跌0.98%，香港恒生則上漲0.5%至26,009點，反映美伊重啟談判帶動的全球情緒改善。油價回落與個別市場的疲弱交錯，區域盤勢震盪。
items.summary_en: Asian equities were mixed on Aug 3: Japan's Nikkei slipped about 0.94% to 63,754.90 and China's CSI 300 eased 0.98%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng edged up 0.5% to 26,009, tracking improved global sentiment on renewed US–Iran talks. Regional trade was choppy as investors weighed easing oil prices against pockets of weakness in individual markets.

items.title_en: Hong Kong signals upward revision to 2026 GDP forecast (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 香港財政司司長陳茂波示意，政府可能於本月稍後上調2026年經濟成長預測，理由是情勢改善；美伊可能重啟外交與油價走軟使區域情緒轉佳。上修展望將強化這個以貿易與金融為主的經濟體的復甦預期，並支撐大中華資產的風險偏好。
items.summary_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan indicated the government is likely to raise its 2026 GDP growth forecast later this month, citing improving conditions, as regional sentiment brightened on the prospect of renewed US–Iran diplomacy and softer oil. An upgraded outlook would reinforce recovery expectations for the city's trade- and finance-driven economy and support risk appetite across Greater China assets.

items.title_zh: 美股本週聚焦財報與關鍵數據（2026-08-03）
items.title_en: Week-ahead: earnings and key data in focus for US markets (2026-08-03)
items.summary_zh: 投資人本週面對財報與經濟數據密集的行事曆，可能左右利率預期，市場已傾向認為聯準會或升息而非降息。油價下跌與地緣風險緩解為週初定下偏正面基調，惟交易員指出，即將公布的就業與通膨數據仍是方向的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Investors entered the week eyeing a packed calendar of corporate earnings and economic releases that could shape rate expectations, with markets already leaning toward the possibility of Fed hikes rather than cuts. Falling oil and easing geopolitical risk set a constructive early tone, but traders flagged that upcoming labor and inflation prints remain the key swing factors for direction.
